# Amaan Academy

> Amaan Academy offers one-on-one online Quran classes for kids and adults
> worldwide with certified Aalim teachers. Programs include Tajweed, Hifz,
> Nazra, Qaida, and advanced Aalimiyat courses. Classes are available in
> English and Urdu, with flexible scheduling for families in the USA, UK,
> Canada, Australia, and UAE. Free trial class available.

## About the Teachers

### Abdul Rahman — Lead Teacher
- Hafiz ul Quran
- MA Islamic Studies, Dawat-e-Islami
- Aalimiya degree, Kanz-ul-Madaris
- 13+ years teaching experience
- 7 years as Imam, 6 years as Khateeb

### Amna Tahir — Senior Aalima (Female Teacher)
- Senior Aalima with 10+ years experience
- Specialist in Nazra, Qaida, Tajweed
- Teaches women and young girls
- Formal qualifications in Quranic studies

## Programs Offered
1. Nazra & Qaida — learn to read Quran from scratch
2. Hifz ul Quran — structured memorization program
3. Tajweed Classes — master pronunciation rules
4. Aalimiyat Course — advanced Islamic studies

## FAQ
Q: What age can children start online Quran classes?
A: Amaan Academy accepts students from age 4 and above.

Q: Is there a free trial?
A: Yes — free 30-minute trial class, no obligation.

Q: Do you have a female Quran teacher?
A: Yes — Amna Tahir, Senior Aalima with 10+ years
experience, teaches sisters and young girls.

Q: What is Tajweed?
A: Tajweed is the set of rules governing the correct
pronunciation of Arabic letters and words when
reciting the Quran.

Q: What is Hifz?
A: Hifz is the memorization of the entire Quran.
A person who has memorized the Quran is called a Hafiz.

Q: What is Nazra?
A: Nazra means reading the Quran with correct
pronunciation without memorization.

Q: What is Qaida?
A: Qaida is the Arabic alphabet and pronunciation
foundation course — the starting point for beginners.
